scope: Reviewed classroom examples, not universal claims about every real-world variant. Not empirical difficulty evidence.
review_notes: Statements about anatomy use normal human anatomy; variations and disabilities are not evaluated or scored as personal characteristics.
Biology models: adult blackbird, adult trout, adult bee/butterfly, oak/green leaf. Do not turn model statements into claims that all fish lay eggs or all flowers contain nectar.

Chemistry: ordinary classroom samples at 20 degrees Celsius, solid unsealed wood, iron, plain wood-pulp paper, cotton, solid bar soap, clear glass. No tasting, heating or home chemical experiment is instructed.
Physics: intended ordinary use of the depicted tools; wheel/gear/pulley rotate, a seesaw pivots. Classification counts assertions, rather than claiming every pictured tool is interchangeable.
Blossom labels are localized per task; generic flower artwork is a schematic blossom, not evidence about every plant species.
